simple.summary: בָּכַר (bâkar) means to give the birthright First listed occurrence: Deut 21 16.

definitions.usage: make firstborn, be firstling, bring forth first child (new fruit).
definitions.full: H1069. bakar [ בָּכַר ] verb (Late Hebrew בְּכֵּר , Aramaic בַּכֵּר , ; compare Arabic rise early, do anything early ; , virgin, woman having her first child ; Ethiopic primogenitus ; Assyrian bukru , first-born , Dl § 65, 5 ) — Pi`el Imperfect יְבַכֵּר Ezek 47:12 ; Infinitive לְבַכֵּר Deut 21:16 ; — 1 bear early, new fruit Ezek 47:12 . 2 make or constitute as first-born Deut 21:16 (denominative of בכיר ). Pu`al Imperfect יְבֻכַּר Lev 27:26 born or made a firstling . Hiph`il Participle f. מַבְכִּירָה Jer 4:31 one bearing her first child .
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root; properly, to burst the womb, i.e. (causatively) bear or make early fruit (of woman or tree); also (as denominative from 1061 )
